stories.title: ¿Quién está detrás de los artistas hechos con IA?: “Al quitar el obstáculo del ser humano podemos ser más arriesgados”

en.title: Who is behind AI-made artists?: "By removing the human obstacle we can be more daring"
en.summary: Creative director Manuel Valencia operates 18 artificial music profiles under his record label Críptica, discussing how removing human constraints allows for greater creative risk-taking.

stories.title: Raúl Incertis, médico español en Gaza: “Perdí la cuenta de los niños heridos que se quedaban sin familia en Gaza”

en.title: Raúl Incertis, Spanish doctor in Gaza: "I lost count of wounded children left without family in Gaza"
en.summary: A Spanish physician who worked at hospitals in Gaza during 2025 has published a book recounting the severe humanitarian suffering he witnessed in the territory.

stories.title: Putin envía a sus tropas las reliquias del príncipe Donskói, mito de su guerra milenaria contra Occidente

en.title: Putin sends his troops relics of Prince Donskói, myth of his millennial war against the West
en.summary: The Kremlin has sent to the front a relic associated with a medieval Moscow prince to legitimize its military campaign as divinely ordained.

stories.title: Entre tropas del Kremlin y aroma soviético en Transnistria, la entelequia pro rusa de Moldavia

en.title: Between Kremlin troops and Soviet aroma in Transnistria, the pro-Russian abstraction of Moldova
en.summary: Transnistria, an unrecognized breakaway region backed by Moscow within Moldova, maintains independent security forces, government, and judiciary while Moldova moves toward EU integration.

stories.title: La película casera que ha conquistado la taquilla china

en.title: The homemade film that has conquered the Chinese box office
en.summary: A feature film called 'Niu Lai' made by an inexperienced young filmmaker and his mother has become a summer phenomenon in China.

stories.title: ¿Quién manda en Al Qaeda? Por qué no hay otro Osama Bin Laden

en.title: Who leads Al Qaeda? Why there is no other Osama Bin Laden
en.summary: Egyptian Saif al Adel, the current leader of the terrorist group, operates from Iran away from public attention, partly due to U.S. military successes against the organization.

stories.title: Detenidos seis pandilleros por acuchillar y dejar dos meses en la UCI a un disidente

en.title: Six gang members arrested for stabbing and leaving a dissident two months in the ICU
en.summary: Six members of the Dominican Don't Play gang were arrested for stabbing a 33-year-old man who was a dissident and former member of the organization, leaving him hospitalized for two months.

stories.title: Seis pandilleros detenidos por el brutal apuñalamiento del 'Nene', ex líder de los DDP de Alcobendas condenado por el crimen de las fiestas de Guadalix en 2017

en.title: Six gang members arrested for brutal stabbing of 'Nene', ex-leader of the DDP in Alcobendas convicted of the 2017 Guadalix party murder
en.summary: Six gang members were arrested for the stabbing of a man in third-degree prison status who had been serving a nine-year sentence for a 2017 murder of an 18-year-old.

stories.title: Raúl Incertis, el horror contado por un médico español en Gaza: "Al despertar, los amputados solo tenían Ibuprofeno y empezaban los alaridos"

en.title: Raúl Incertis, the horror recounted by a Spanish doctor in Gaza: "Upon waking, amputees had only Ibuprofen and the screaming would begin"
en.summary: A Spanish anesthesiologist who worked for months in Gaza has documented conditions there for the UN. In his book, he describes the scale of violence and medical hardships faced by injured patients.

stories.title: Arabia Saudí cierra el oleoducto Este-Oeste, vía que usaba como alternativa a Ormuz

en.title: Saudi Arabia closes East-West pipeline, alternative route to Hormuz
en.summary: Saudi Arabia has shut down the East-West pipeline, which served as an alternative supply route to global markets amid tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Arabia Saudí cierra el oleoducto alternativo a Ormuz tras la ofensiva de los hutíes en el mar Rojo

en.title: Saudi Arabia closes alternative pipeline to Hormuz after Houthi offensive in Red Sea
en.summary: Attacks on the alternative pipeline to Hormuz caused injuries, prompting emergency teams to secure the pipeline and assess its safety.

stories.title: La escalada en el mar Rojo obliga a Arabia Saudí a cerrar su único oleoducto alternativo a Ormuz

en.title: Red Sea escalation forces Saudi Arabia to close only alternative pipeline to Hormuz
en.summary: The Red Sea crisis has forced Saudi Arabia to shut its sole alternative pipeline to Hormuz as Houthis expand their control in Yemen, intensifying threats to oil markets.

stories.title: Bancos: cómo subirse al tirón en Bolsa

en.title: Banks: how to ride the stock market wave
en.summary: Rising interest rates improve sector expectations despite valuations at record levels. Experts recommend selective investment after six consecutive years of gains in the stock market.

stories.title: Cómo armar la cartera de inversión tras la subida de tipos

en.title: How to build your investment portfolio after interest rate increases
en.summary: The European Central Bank raised rates to 2.50% and the Federal Reserve may increase its rates next week. Investors should adapt their portfolios to the new interest rate environment.

en.title: Where is oil heading?
en.summary: Escalating Middle East conflict with attacks on energy infrastructure increases supply disruption concerns, pushing oil prices higher despite weakening demand from elevated prices.

stories.title: VW, Toyota y Stellantis llevan a récord los ingresos del automóvil

en.title: VW, Toyota and Stellantis drive automotive revenue to record levels
en.summary: Inflation and sales of higher-equipped models boost major automakers' revenue to over 1.04 trillion, though profitability remains at minimum levels.

stories.title: Apple lleva el iPhone a una escala inédita de precios: hasta 3.839 euros

en.title: Apple takes iPhone to unprecedented price scale: up to 3,839 euros
en.summary: Apple has increased prices across its mobile phone lineup by up to 26%, presenting a significant challenge for new CEO John Ternus following the foldable Duo launch.
